study.scope: Selected historical development scenes, including reused results and authorized recovery attempts. Not an independent held-out benchmark or a full-leaderboard score. comparison_scope: U08 and C10 use the contemporaneous six-case development comparison from October 22, 2026. The reference attempts belong to a different batch from the earlier aggregate 72-case evaluation and are not a pure-VLA baseline. The traces support a combined progress-review, context, and instruction-adjustment mechanism; they do not isolate one phrase or threshold as the cause.
